label: Limited administrative capacity
text: National authorities may be slow to organise a coordinated public response

label: Unsettled political situation
text: An announcement may be drawn into existing political tensions or meet public disorder

label: Limited independent media reach
text: News of an announcement may reach the public late, in part, or reframed by domestic media

label: Constrained reporting
text: Journalists may be reluctant to question or explain an announcement freely, so independent explanation will be scarce

label: Online access can be restricted
text: Online access to information about an announcement could be limited at short notice

label: Lower trust in official statements
text: Official statements are less likely to be taken at face value

label: Unrest above its usual level
text: An announcement would compete with, or could add to, current domestic unrest

label: Recent pressure on the media
text: Media outlets may be cautious about how they report an announcement

label: International tension above its usual level
text: An announcement may be read through the lens of current international tensions

label: International contact below its usual level
text: Coordinating with international bodies may take longer than usual
